ux.title: UX Design

agile.title: Agile Methods
agile.intro: We coach and help your organization adapt agile principles to your needs.
agile.desc: Whether you want to implement Scrum at the team level or scale up to SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) at the organizational level, we help you build efficient, self-organizing teams and transparent workflows.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: It started with a vision to gather expert specialists and build proven models and processes to deliver real value to our clients.
about.story_p1: Reqcon was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in central Stockholm. The vision has been to gather a team of knowledgeable experts to build proven models and processes internally based on our know-how and many years of experience to deliver real value to our clients – regardless of industry.
about.story_p2: Reqcon's cornerstone lies in requirements analysis (business analysis), but as a company we have recently expanded our competence areas. The goal is to turn that vision into reality. Today, Reqcon has expanded its operations to Gothenburg and has the ambition to deliver its services throughout Sweden.
about.tagline: When you invest in us, we invest in you

policy.title: Personnel Policy
policy.subtitle: We prioritize a safe, professional, and balanced workplace. Read or download our official policy document.

1.title: 1. Purpose
1.text: This personnel policy aims to create a safe, inclusive, and professional working environment for our employees. The policy clarifies our values, expectations, and guidelines for how we work together within the company and at client sites.

2.title: 2. Scope
2.text: The policy applies to all employees, consultants, interns, and hired staff at Reqcon.

3.title: 3. Our Goal
3.text: Reqcon shall be a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and has good conditions to perform their work. We strive for a work environment free from illness, accidents, discrimination, and harassment.

4.title: 4. Core Values
4.text: We operate on the following 5 fundamental principles in all our work:
bullets: Professionalism: We represent our company and our clients with respect, punctuality, and quality.
Trust: We believe in openness and accountability.
Communication: We communicate with respect, clarity, and openness. Our communication should be inclusive, fostering trust and collaboration.
Commitment: We are solution-oriented, proactive, and value our clients' needs. We care for one another within the company and support each other in our work.
Balance: We value a healthy balance between work and personal life.

5.title: 5. Work Environment
5.text: We strive for an inclusive and safe work environment where everyone is treated with respect - regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, functional diversity, or sexual orientation. Offensive treatment, bullying, harassment, or manipulation ("toxic behavior") is not accepted.

6.title: 6. Communication
6.text: We encourage open, direct, and respectful communication – both internally and externally. Views, suggestions for improvement, or concerns should be raised without fear of retaliation.

7.title: 7. Working Hours & Flexibility
7.text: We apply flexible working hours as far as the assignment allows. Consultants primarily follow the client's hours, but we strive for balance and recovery.

8.title: 8. Remote Work
8.text: Remote work is permitted upon agreement with the immediate manager, in dialogue with the client, and as contractually agreed. We expect accessibility and professional conduct regardless of the workplace.

9.title: 9. Professional Development
9.text: We encourage continuous learning through training, certifications, and experience sharing. Each employee is responsible for their own development – we support them with time and resources.

10.title: 10. Loyalty & Confidentiality
10.text: All information regarding the company, colleagues, and clients is handled confidentially. The consultant role often entails access to sensitive information – confidentiality must always be respected.

11.title: 11. Follow-up
11.text: The policy is followed up during performance reviews and revised at least annually by the management team.

12.title: 12. Approval
12.text: This policy is effective from 2025-06-03, approved and signed by the management team of Reqcon.
